initial_plan.can_answer_question: partly: the data cannot measure motorist fatality risk per mile because it contains no miles-driven or vehicle-miles-traveled exposure; it can show the share of reported crash deaths that were motorists
initial_plan.metric: annual share of all reported crash deaths that were motorist deaths: sum(number_of_motorist_killed) / sum(number_of_persons_killed)
initial_plan.denominator: sum of number_of_persons_killed in the same year among records with both death fields nonmissing
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC crash records with a usable crash_date year and nonmissing number_of_motorist_killed and number_of_persons_killed; count the reported deaths in those records
filters: number_of_motorist_killed and number_of_persons_killed are both nonmissing
initial_plan.years: calendar years 2013-2025 inclusive, assigned from crash_date

data_check.meaning_and_decisions: Among 2,132,218 dated crash rows in 2013-2025, number_of_motorist_killed is complete, but number_of_persons_killed is missing on 36 rows (2 in 2016, 16 in 2017, 14 in 2018, 1 in 2020, and 3 in 2025), or about 0.0017% of dated rows. Exclude these 36 records from both numerator and denominator so the share uses a matched population; the final population has 2,132,182 rows. There are 0 crash rows with missing crash_date in the file, which are unassignable to a year. Every selected year, including 2025, has date endpoints of Jan 1 and Dec 31, but this does not establish daily reporting completeness; retain and disclose the limitation. The two death columns are integer counts; for summed columns the check is limited to missingness, as planned.
data_check.changed_from_initial_plan: No metric change; the data check confirms the planned complete-case rule excludes 36 rows with missing total deaths, and adds the date-coverage caveat.

final_plan.can_answer_question: no for risk per mile: vehicle-miles-traveled is absent; partly for the different outcome mix proxy of motorist deaths as a share of reported deaths
final_plan.denominator: all reported persons killed in the same year, summed over crash records where both death fields are nonmissing
final_plan.population: police-reported NYC crashes dated in calendar years 2013-2025 with nonmissing values in both number_of_motorist_killed and number_of_persons_killed; numerator and denominator use this same complete-case population
filters: crash_date is nonmissing and its calendar year is 2013-2025
final_plan.limitations: The data has no vehicle-miles-traveled or other miles-driven exposure, so a motorist-death share is not risk per mile and cannot establish whether that risk declined. The final population excludes 36 of 2,132,218 dated crash rows (about 0.0017%) because number_of_persons_killed is missing; number_of_motorist_killed is complete. The 2025 date endpoints span Jan 1 through Dec 31, as do the other years, but date endpoints do not establish complete reporting on every day; police-reported crashes only are represented. There are 0 records with missing crash_date in the file.
